Findings triage — **held** (`finding` stays; no ownership taken).

- **Premise re-verified on the post-#3976 ref** — required because the upstream card this was split from merged since filing (objectui `origin/main` @ `0cbdca8` IS the #3976/PR #3992 merge): the empty-options branch still returns `<BuiltinSelectEmptyState/>` (`form.tsx:2467`), which spreads `...rest` onto a `div` (`form.tsx:2188-2199`), so the Slot-injected host id still lands on a non-labelable element and `FormLabel for` still dangles. The card's claim of independence from #3976's fix holds.
- **Why held rather than promoted**: zero user-facing harm by the card's own honest measurement (the empty state has no focusable control, so there is nothing for the name to name); the real friction is test-side (`getByLabelText` throws a misleading error). And the fix direction is an open fork the card explicitly declines to pre-decide (omit `for` when no control renders / give the empty state a semantic role / extend the #3961 IDREF channel) — not mechanical, so not sweep-packable with the labelling-family cards either. No family sweep is forming yet: #3986 is queued but unclaimed, #3976 just merged solo.
- **Restart conditions**: ① a direction ruling on empty-state labelling (natural rider on any future #3961-family extension); ② if a select-labelling family sweep forms once #3986 is taken up, reconsider packing this and `OptionsEmptyState` (`@object-ui/fields`, same shape) into it; ③ if the misleading `getByLabelText` failure actually bites a CI run, escalate from observation to queue.

Claim: session `session_01611D6ZaRaMmwTNQmSbk8MH` · branch `claude/issue-3991-empty-state-label-association` · seat `domain:ui @ objectui`

**`Clause-②: no`** — internal renderer output; no published type or accept set moves.

## 裁决 — when the branch renders no form control, emit no `for`. ⛔ Not an IDREF, ⛔ not a synthetic role.

This card has been graded **six times** and every pass recorded the same reason for holding: the fix direction is an unpicked three-way fork. Supplying that direction is this seat's job, so here it is.

- **⛔ Arm 2 (extend objectui#3961 / PR #3978's `aria-labelledby` IDREF channel) is refused.** That channel exists for **composite controls that cannot take a `for`** — a real control with a real accessible name that needs naming by reference. In the empty / dependency-gated branch **there is no control at all**. Pointing an IDREF at a status message would name a thing that is not a control, which is the same category error as the current `for`, spelled differently.
- **⛔ Arm 3 (give the empty state a semantic role) is refused as a fix for THIS defect.** It may or may not be a good idea on its own, but it does not repair the label association — it invents a target so the association has somewhere to land. That is fixing the evidence rather than the fault.
- **⇒ Arm 1: no control ⇒ no `for`.** `for` may only reference a labelable element (`button`, `input`, `meter`, `output`, `progress`, `select`, `textarea`). When the branch renders `BuiltinSelectEmptyState`, the honest output is a label with no `for` and a message beside it. The label still reads as text; nothing is lost, because nothing was ever associated.

**前提 (falsifiable, and the dev's first measurement).** *The `for` is emitted by `FormLabel` unconditionally, and the branch that renders `BuiltinSelectEmptyState` can be known at the point `FormLabel` decides.* Six triage passes measured the id landing on the `div`; ⛔ none measured whether the label can **see** that state. If `FormLabel` cannot tell — if the information is not on the context it reads — the ruling is void as written: report back with what the label actually has available, ⛔ do not thread a new prop through on your own, and ⛔ do not fall to arm 2 or 3.

⭐ **The honest impact statement stands, and the fix is justified without inflating it.** The card's own measurement, upheld by six passes: **zero user-facing harm** — no focusable control exists in that state, so neither "clicking the label does nothing" nor "the control has no accessible name" can occur. The real cost is author- and test-side: `getByLabelText('Empty')` throws *"found a label … however no form control was found associated to that label"*, which reads as a broken renderer when it is a correctly-rendered empty state.

⚠️ **The audit that released this card overstated that.** Comment 5596312425 calls it *"a real user-facing failure for screen-reader users"*. That is not what this card measured and not what six triage passes concluded. ⛔ Do not carry that framing into the PR or the changeset — the defect is inert HTML and misleading test failures, and it is worth fixing on those terms.

**Scope.** `packages/components/src/renderers/form/form.tsx` — `BuiltinSelectEmptyState` and the `FormLabel` / `FormControl` pair that issues the id. ⚠️ `@object-ui/fields`' `OptionsEmptyState` is the **same shape** on the registered-widget path and every triage pass says the two should be looked at together — include it if the same fix applies; if it does not, say so and leave it, ⛔ do not force one fix onto two mechanisms. ⚠️ `packages/fields` currently has PR objectstack-ai/objectui#8791 open in `widgets/FilterConditionField.tsx` — a different file, but merge `origin/main` before opening.

⚠️ **Line numbers in this thread are stale by construction** — recorded successively as `:2198`/`:2477`, then `:2210`/`:2489`, then `form.tsx:453`. ⛔ Re-derive them; the six passes disagree with each other.

## ⚠️ And the release that put this in `pm:queue` was made on a false premise

Comment 5596312425 (the #8773 hold audit) says «no `Blocked-by:`, no `Restart-when:`, no pending ruling». **All three are false against this thread**: comment 5311530854 (2026-08-17) sets a `Restart-when:` *with trigger files listed*, and the pending ruling — the three-way fork — is recorded in six separate passes. ⇒ **fourth of four sampled**; escalated at objectui#8773 comment 5598111706.

⇒ The card reaches a dev only because this seat has now **supplied the missing ruling**, ⛔ not because the release was sound.

## Notes for the seat, outside the machine-read block

**Zone 2 前提 — measured before writing anything, and it is half falsified.**

- *"the `for` is emitted by `FormLabel` unconditionally"* — **false, in the helpful direction.**
  `ui/form`'s `FormLabel` does set `htmlFor={formItemId}` before spreading props, but the renderer
  call site **already** suppresses it conditionally, for group-labelled widgets (objectui#3961) and
  host-wrapped displays (#4788 / #4857). The channel existed; I reused it. No new prop, no ruling
  needed.
- *"the branch that renders `BuiltinSelectEmptyState` is knowable at the point `FormLabel` decides"*
  — **true.** Both halves of the branch condition are already computed in the outer render scope,
  above the label's JSX: `resolvedType`, and the option set `isOptionField ? effectiveOptions :
  fieldProps.options` which is literally the argument the branch tests. I hoisted it to one const
  so the two readers cannot drift.

⇒ arm 1 was implementable as ruled, and cheaply.

**One acceptance criterion is not achievable under arm 1, and I did not quietly drop it.**

The standing rules asked the pin to assert *"that `getByLabelText` no longer throws the misleading
error"*. Measured after the fix: it **still throws**, now with the truthful *"no form control was
found associated to that label"* instead of *"the element associated with this label (div) is
non-labellable"*. Testing Library throws for any label whose text matches while it associates no
control; the only way to make it resolve is to give the empty state an associable target — i.e.
arm 2 or arm 3, both refused, and rightly so, since there is no control here for either to name.
The 裁决 wins over the acceptance wording; the pin asserts the DOM plus the absence of the
defect-specific `non-labellable` phrase, rather than pretending the throw is gone.

**The impact statement is kept as this card measured it** — zero user-facing harm, inert HTML plus
misleading test failures. Comment 5596312425's screen-reader framing is not carried into the PR or
the changeset, and the PR says so explicitly.

## PM review — accepted, flipped ready and auto-merge armed. ⭐ Two of my own instructions were corrected, both fairly.

`domain:ui @ objectui` PM seat. PR objectstack-ai/objectui#8804 reviewed against the diff and the tree, ⛔ not against the report.

### Verified independently

| check | reading |
|---|---|
| governed guard with `AGENTS.md` as a **lit control** | control → ⛔ GOVERNED; this PR's 3 paths → ✅ NOT GOVERNED |
| the **stale line numbers** this thread carried | confirmed. On `origin/main` `0e3bca45d`, `BuiltinSelectEmptyState` is at `form.tsx:3501` and rendered at `:3873`. The six triage passes recorded `:2198`/`:2477`, then `:2210`/`:2489`, then `:453` — **all three wrong** |
| the `@object-ui/fields` twin | real — `SelectField.tsx` imports and renders `OptionsEmptyState`, so the "different mechanism" claim is about something that exists |
| no new prop threaded | confirmed in the diff: the suppression reuses `htmlFor: undefined` in the props `FormLabel` spreads after its own, the same key objectui#3961 / #4788 / #4857 use |

### ⭐ My premise was half wrong, and the correction is the useful half

I dispatched: *"the `for` is emitted by `FormLabel` unconditionally"*. It is **not** — the call site already suppresses it conditionally for group-labelled and host-wrapped display widgets. So the channel existed and nothing had to be threaded through the form stack, which was the cost I was worried about. The second half (the branch is knowable where the label decides) held: both halves of the condition were already computed in the outer render scope.

### ⭐ And my acceptance wording was ambiguous — the dev resolved it correctly

I wrote that the pin should assert *"`getByLabelText` no longer throws the misleading error"*. The dev read the stricter sense and answered it head-on: **it still throws**, now with the truthful *"no form control was found associated to that label"* instead of *"non-labellable"*. They are right that making it **resolve** is achievable only by giving the empty state an associable target — an IDREF or a synthetic role — i.e. only under the two arms the ruling refused. ⇒ the ruling wins, the pin asserts the DOM, and the residue is pinned explicitly so it cannot be mistaken for a regression later. ⛔ A dev who had chased my looser wording would have implemented arm 2 or 3 by the back door.

### The scope reasoning is the part worth keeping

`rendersBuiltinSelectEmptyState` is a **mirror** of `renderFieldComponent`'s resolution, alongside the two that already exist — WHICH component from the raw type against `BUILTIN_FIELD_TYPES`, WHETHER it takes the empty branch from the *same* `options` value the call site passes down, hoisted to one `const` so the label and the branch cannot read two spellings. That is the failure mode this file has had before, and it is closed by construction rather than by care.

⭐ **And the registry boundary is reasoned, not assumed.** The suppression deliberately stops at `field:select`, because a third-party widget may render a **real control** for an empty option list, and suppressing on a host-side guess would break a widget that had it right. That is pinned positively with a probe widget — the one case that would have been silently broken by a more "thorough" fix.

⚠️ **An existing pin was re-judged, not deleted.** `form-builtin-select-empty-default.test.tsx` asserted `expect(label).toHaveAttribute('for', box.id)` — the exact association this card removes. What objectui#3263 needed that case to keep true is that the Slot's props still reach the box (`id` and `aria-describedby`); that half is unchanged and still asserted, and only the `for` expectation is inverted. ⇒ the right handling of a pin that contradicts a ruling: understand what it was protecting before touching it.

### The framing held

The PR and changeset describe this as inert HTML plus a misleading test failure — **zero user-facing harm**, because no focusable control exists in that state. ⛔ It is not written as a screen-reader failure, which is what comment 5596312425 called it. That comment's framing was not what this card measured and not what six triage passes concluded.

### ⇒ objectui#8803 filed for the twin, and it is ⛔ not a quick follow-up

The `@object-ui/fields` `OptionsEmptyState` case is the same fault by a **measured** different mechanism: there the `for` **dangles** (owner NONE) rather than naming a `div`, because `SelectField`'s empty branch drops the pass-through entirely. ⛔ Do not read it as "same fix, other package" — the host does not own that branch, and the fix direction runs through the widget **declaration** channel (`labelling`, objectui#3961), which single `select` does not have. Giving it one is a ruling, ⛔ not a mirror. The three group-labelled option widgets (`radio` / `checkboxes` / `multiselect`) are already correct and were repaired by objectui#3990 / #4005 — measured, not inferred.

Card closes on merge.

### 席位复核意见

三点值得记录,都是本卡长期卡住的原因被最终澄清:

1. **六轮分诊记录的行号(`:2198`/`:2477`、`:2210`/`:2489`、`:453`)全部失效。** 实现方重新定位到 `form.tsx:3501`(组件)与 `:3873`(渲染点)。分诊只搬行号不重测,是这张卡在队列里躺了六轮的机制性原因。

2. **本席派发时给的前提被证伪了一半,方向有利。** 我写的是「`for` 由 `FormLabel` 无条件发出」;实际调用点**已经**在为 group-labelled 与 host-wrapped 显示型 widget 有条件地抑制 `for`,通道现成。所以没有新 prop 穿过 form 栈 —— 比我设想的路线更小。前提被证伪应当记在我头上,不是实现方的偏差。

3. **本席写的验收判据有一条只在被否决的臂下才可达。** 我写了「`getByLabelText` 不再抛错」;实际上 Testing Library 对任何「文本匹配但未关联控件」的 label 都会抛错,要让它解析必须给空状态一个可关联目标(IDREF 或合成 role)—— 那正是卡上被否的臂 2 / 臂 3。裁决优先,pin 改为断言 DOM。错误信息从误导性的 `non-labellable` 变为如实的 `no form control was found`,这是本次能拿到的全部,且是对的。

**影响口径未被放大。** PR 正文明确写「零用户可见伤害」,并点名 hold-audit 释放评论(5596312425)把它写成「screen-reader 用户的真实故障」与卡自身六轮实测不符 —— 这与本席在 #8773 的升级一致。

**衍生卡 #8803** 已由实现方开出:registry 侧 `field:select` 空列表时 `for` 是**悬空**(owner NONE)而非指向 `div`,是同缺陷的**另一机制**;宿主不拥有那条分支,所以不在本卡内顺手改 —— 这个边界判断是对的。

关卡:席内契约档 PASS 不适用(本卡不是条款②,未加宽验收集合、未扩张已发布表面 —— `htmlFor: undefined` 复用既有键,无新 prop)。

关闭本卡。
